offer.seoDescription: Control a quiet waterless scent tower from your phone and create a consistent atmosphere across larger living spaces.
offer.bodyHtml:
Turn fragrance into part of the room rather than another object to hide. Aura Tower combines a slim metal silhouette with waterless diffusion and Bluetooth control for intentional home atmosphere.

Designed for larger rooms

  • Waterless fragrance diffusion
  • Bluetooth smart control and timer
  • Quiet operation rated at 40 dB or below
  • Metal tower body in a champagne finish
  • US plug configuration

What to know

This offer is for the champagne-color tower with a US plug. Fragrance oil is sold separately. Supplier transit for the verified production quantity is estimated at 17–24 days before domestic fulfillment.

Frequently asked questions

Does it need water?

No. It is designed for waterless fragrance diffusion.

Can I schedule it?

The supplier lists Bluetooth smart control and timer functionality.

Is oil included?

No fragrance oil is promised with this offer.
